# Locally hosted startup scripts

These files are copied from the npm packages at the versions below. Keep the
order in themes/shoka/_config.yml when updating them because app.js uses
their browser globals. The packages' license metadata is shown here; license
files included in the archives are in licenses/ .

File npm package License
pace.min.js pace-js@1.0.2 MIT
pjax.min.js pjax@0.2.8 MIT
fetch.umd.js whatwg-fetch@3.4.0 MIT
anime.min.js animejs@3.2.0 MIT
algoliasearch-lite.umd.js algoliasearch@4.14.3 MIT
instantsearch.production.min.js instantsearch.js@4.56.1 MIT
lozad.min.js lozad@1.16.0 MIT
quicklink.umd.js quicklink@2.3.0 Apache-2.0

whatwg-fetch@3.4.0 does not ship a minified UMD file in its npm archive,
so the unminified dist/fetch.umd.js is used. The algoliasearch@4.14.3
archive declares MIT in package.json but does not include a license file.
